The corner pool's stickers are the strongest of any position here (eight in twenty, including Dee Alford and Decobie Durant, both now NFL starters) — and Alford, a 5-11 Tusculum corner who signed through the CFL, is the shape of his path. His 78.4 coverage grade and 29% completion rate allowed are the traits those signings were built on.
case_against: The sample is thin — 57 coverage snaps and 7 targets in 2026, after a 2025 season at Utah with no game action. His band's likely rung is the claim itself, and the claim currently rests on seven throws.

Seven targets. No interceptions, two breakups, and no verified speed on file for the position where the forty is the argument.
